There is no authoritative per-technique mapping for CVE/KEV/OWASP/CWE; entries here are curated by the security team to add context and are labelled 'illustrative' in the report. T1548.002.notes: UAC bypass is commonly chained after initial execution to gain administrative context before credential access or persistence.

T1003.001.notes: LSASS credential theft is a top precursor to lateral movement in BFSI intrusions; prioritise Credential Guard / LSA protection.
